description.value: South Surrey Indoor Pool is a City of Surrey public recreation facility offering drop-in swimming, weight room access, a sauna, and a hot tub. Located in the South Surrey neighbourhood near the White Rock border, it serves the broader community as an affordable fitness and leisure destination. Touring cyclists passing through the area may find it a convenient stop for a post-ride swim and recovery.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the facility is an active public indoor pool operated by the City of Surrey, with a pool status page updated May 24, 2026, showing main pool, wading pool, sauna, and hot tub all open. The address (14655 17 Avenue, Surrey, BC V4A 5M2) and phone (604-502-6220) are confirmed by the website. No explicit mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, showers, or any cycling-specific amenities appears in the fetched content, so all amenity fields remain null despite the near-certainty that a public pool has change rooms.
concerns: OSM record had no phone number; phone sourced from website only.
